32-bit probe
------------
PASS: API/layout probe compiled as ELF i386 with GCC -m32
PASS: fixed-point source object compiled with GCC -m32
Measured 32-bit layout with default capacities:
  FPI_Context  = 1,340,672 bytes
  FPI_AST      =   597,004 bytes
  FPI_Registry =    53,260 bytes

A complete 32-bit executable was not linked in this environment because the
container does not include the full i386 libc development headers/libraries;
sources that include stdio stop at the missing multilib header. No MinGW i686
cross-compiler was installed. Therefore Windows/MinGW32 execution is not
claimed here, although the core and public layout passed 32-bit compilation
probes.
